arxiv-2103-06838.title: Modelling the Multiwavelength Variability of Mrk 335 using Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2103-06838.creator: Ryan-Rhys Griffiths, Jiachen Jiang, Douglas J.K. Buisson, Dan Wilkins, Luigi C. Gallo, Adam Ingram, Alpha A. Lee, Dirk Grupe, Erin Kara, Michael L. Parker, William Alston, Anthony Bourached, George Cann, Andrew Young, S. Komossa
arxiv-2103-06838.description: Abstract The optical and UV variability of the majority of AGN may be related to the reprocessing of rapidly-changing X-ray emission from a more compact region near the central black hole. Such a reprocessing model would be characterised by lags between X-ray and optical/UV emission due to differences in light travel time.

arxiv-2106-06387.title: Canonical models of modular curves and the Galois action on CM-points
arxiv-2106-06387.creator: C.Daw, B.Zilber
arxiv-2106-06387.description: Abstract We use the theory of canonical models of Shimura varieties to describe the projective limit of the curves \mathbb{Y}(N), all N, and its automorphism group. In particular we prove that the Galois group of {\mathbb{Q}} (CM) over {\mathbb{Q}} is an open subgroup of an automorphism group of an explicitly given adelic structure.

arxiv-2112-05640.title: Fast and scalable neuroevolution deep learning architecture search for multivariate anomaly detection
arxiv-2112-05640.creator: Marcin Pietroń, Dominik Żurek, Kamil Faber, Roberto Corizzo
arxiv-2112-05640.description: Abstract Neuroevolution is one of the methodologies that can be used for learning optimal architecture during training. It uses evolutionary algorithms to generate the topology of artificial neural networks (ANN) and its parameters. The main benefits are that it is scalable and can be fully or partially non-gradient method.

arxiv-2203-07337.title: Phenomenology of Double Descent in Finite-Width Neural Networks
arxiv-2203-07337.creator: Sidak Pal Singh, Aurelien Lucchi, Thomas Hofmann, Bernhard Schölkopf
arxiv-2203-07337.description: Abstract ‘Double descent’ delineates the generalization behaviour of models depending on the regime they belong to: under- or over-parameterized. The current theoretical understanding behind the occurrence of this phenomenon is primarily based on linear and kernel regression models — with informal parallels to neural networks via the Neural Tangent Kernel.

arxiv-2312-03363.title: Darboux transformations of spacelike curves in the Lorentz-Minkowski plane
arxiv-2312-03363.creator: Masaya Hara
arxiv-2312-03363.description: Abstract . This paper concerns (Lorentz-)Darboux transformations in the Lorentz-Minkowski plane ℝ 1 , 1 \displaystyle\mathbb{R}^{1,1} . We use the Penrose diagram for conformal compactification and show some unique properties of Darboux transformations of spacelike curves in ℝ 1 , 1 \displaystyle\mathbb{R}^{1,1} , especially with regard to singularities and blowup.

arxiv-2408-00834.title: Variational wave-functions for correlated metals
arxiv-2408-00834.creator: Ankush Chaubey, Harsh Nigam, Subhro Bhattacharjee, K. Sengupta
arxiv-2408-00834.description: Abstract We study a set of many-body wave-functions of Fermions that are naturally written using momentum space basis and allow for quantum superposition of Fermion occupancy, { n 𝐤 } \{n_{\bf k}\} . This enables us to capture the fluctuations of the Fermi-surface (FS) – the singularly most important signature of a metal.

arxiv-2501-17346.title: Role of interface mixing on coherent heat conduction in periodic and aperiodic superlattices
arxiv-2501-17346.creator: Theodore Maranets, Evan Doe, Yan Wang
arxiv-2501-17346.description: Abstract Superlattices (SLs) can induce phonon coherence through the periodic layering of two or more materials, enabling tailored thermal transport properties. While most theoretical studies assume atomically sharp, perfect interfaces, real SLs often feature atomic interdiffusion spanning approximately a single atomic layer or more. Such interface mixing can significantly influence phonon coherence and transport behavior.

arxiv-2505-07206.creator: yuncong Liu \authormark 1, Wenhan Sun \authormark 2, Hamed Abiri \authormark 3, Philip X.-L. arxiv-2505-07206.description: Abstract Silicon carbide (SiC) has great potential for optomechanical applications due to its outstanding optical and mechanical properties. However, challenges associated with SiC nanofabrication have constrained its adoption in optomechanical devices, as embodied by the considerable optical loss or lack of integrated optical access in existing mechanical resonators.

arxiv-2506-22415.title: Linear operators preserving volume polynomials
arxiv-2506-22415.creator: Lukas Grund, June Huh, Mateusz Michałek, Hendrik Süss, Botong Wang
arxiv-2506-22415.description: Abstract . Volume polynomials measure the growth of Minkowski sums of convex bodies and of tensor powers of positive line bundles on projective varieties. We show that Aluffi’s covolume polynomials are precisely the polynomial differential operators that preserve volume polynomials, reflecting a duality between homology and cohomology. We then present several applications to matroid theory. 1.

arxiv-2511-18498.title: DEXO: A Secure and Fair Exchange Mechanism for Decentralized IoT Data Markets This is the authors’ accepted version of the published article: Y. Li, I. Alom, W. Sun, and Y. Xiao, “DEXO: A Secure and Fair Exchange Mechanism for Decentralized IoT Data Markets,” IEEE Internet of Things Journal , vol. 1
arxiv-2511-18498.creator: Yue Li 1 , Ifteher Alom 1 , Wenhai Sun 2 , Yang Xiao 1
arxiv-2511-18498.description: Abstract Opening up data produced by the Internet of Things (IoT) and mobile devices for public utilization can maximize their economic value. Challenges remain in the trustworthiness of the data sources and the security of the trading process, particularly when there is no trust between the data providers and consumers.

plos-pone-0007071.title: Disturbance Alters the Phylogenetic Composition and Structure of Plant Communities in an Old Field System
plos-pone-0007071.creator: Russell Dinnage
plos-pone-0007071.description: PLOS ONE research article. The changes in phylogenetic composition and structure of communities during succession following disturbance can give us insights into the forces that are shaping communities over time. In abandoned agricultural fields, community composition changes rapidly when a field is plowed

pmc-10608915.title: Integration of Inkjet Printed Graphene as a Hole Transport Layer in Organic Solar Cells
pmc-10608915.creator: Julia Kastner, Flavia Tomarchio, Nicolas Decorde, Matthias Kehrer, Günter Hesser, Anita Fuchsbauer, Ammar Armghan, Shobhit K Patel, Juveriya Parmar
pmc-10608915.description: This work demonstrates the green production of a graphene ink for inkjet printing and its use as a hole transport layer (HTL) in an organic solar cell. Graphene as an HTL improves the selective hole extraction at the anode and prevents charge recombination at the electronic interface and metal diffusion into the photoactive layer.

pmc-10622528.title: Daily flow prediction of the Huayuankou hydrometeorological station based on the coupled CEEMDAN–SE–BiLSTM model
pmc-10622528.creator: Haiyang Li, Xianqi Zhang, Shifeng Sun, Yihao Wen, Qiuwen Yin
pmc-10622528.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Enhancing flood forecasting accuracy, promoting rational water resource utilization and management, and mitigating river disasters all hinge on the crucial role of improving the accuracy of daily flow prediction. The coupled model of Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN), Sample Entropy (SE), and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) demonstrates higher stability when faced with nonlinear and non-stationary data, stronger adaptability to various types and lengths of time series data by utilizing sample entropy, and significant advantages in processing sequential

pmc-11388041.title: Synchronous retroperitoneal liposarcoma and gastric adenocarcinoma: A rare case report
pmc-11388041.creator: Sara Essetti, Kaoutar Imrani, Chaymae Faraj, Rachida Chehrastane, Sara Ez-zaky, Nabil Moatassim Billah, Ittimade Nassar, Amina Alaoui Babana, Youssef Ouazzani Touhami, Hadj Omar El Malki, Lahcen Ifrine, Abdelkader Belkouchi, Omar Belkouchi, Rihane El Mohtarim, Samia Sassi, Sabrine Derqaoui, Zakiya B
pmc-11388041.description: Multiple primary malignancies can occur as either synchronous or metachronous tumors, particularly in adults. Retroperitoneal liposarcoma is a rare malignancy arising from adipose tissue, while gastric adenocarcinoma is one of the most common neoplasms worldwide. The simultaneous occurrence of these 2 malignancies is extremely rare, with only 1 case reported worldwide.

pmc-11493260.title: Treatment preferences in spinal muscular atrophy: A swing weighting study for caregivers of patients with SMA types 1 and 2
pmc-11493260.creator: Anish Patel, Walter Toro, Siobhan Bourke, Yemi Oluboyede, Sylvaine Barbier, Nataliya Bogoeva, Sandra P. Reyna, Omar Dabbous
pmc-11493260.description: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is a genetic neuromuscular disorder characterized by skeletal muscle weakness and atrophy. Patients with SMA types 1 and 2 develop severe disabilities conferring substantial patient and caregiver burden. Caregiver treatment characteristic preferences are useful for informing treatment choices and improving adherence.

pmc-12410576.title: A robust deep learning framework for cerebral microbleeds recognition in GRE and SWI MRI
pmc-12410576.creator: Tahereh Hassanzadeh, Sonal Sachdev, Wei Wen, Perminder S Sachdev, Arcot Sowmya
pmc-12410576.description: Highlights•We propose a patch-based 3D CNN for detecting cerebral microbleeds (CMB).•Various scenarios are considered to address the challenges of both large and small datasets.We provide guidelines for configuring the model to prioritise higher accuracy or robustness in detecting CMB, particularly in normal cases.•To our knowledge, this is the first study leveraging the ADNI dataset for automatic CMB detection.

pmc-12473698.description: This study quantifies how pressurized water-immersion aging degrades the tribological response of cross-ply E-glass/polyester laminates by coupling dual-mode testing with surface metrology and factorial ANOVA. Eleven-ply [0/90]s plates were aged at 10 bar for 0, 7, 14, and 21 days, gaining 10% mass (72.2 to 79.

pmc-12534986.title: Distinct genetic patterns and natural history of OPA1-related auditory neuropathy in Chinese population
pmc-12534986.creator: Hongyang Wang, Tao Shi, Wenjia Wang, Jin Li, Ziyi Chen, Lan Lan, Linyi Xie, Fen Xiong, Dayong Wang, Jing Guan, Qiuju Wang
pmc-12534986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAuditory neuropathy (AN) represents a clinical manifestation of OPA1-related diseases. The diagnostic process of these diseases is challenging owing to the broad spectrum of intermediate phenotypes and diverse inherited patterns. The aim of this study was to comprehensively delineate the feature of OPA1-related patients in a Chinese AN cohort, encompassing the incident rate, inherited pattern, detailed audiological characteristics, and genotype-phenotype correlation.MethodsBetween 2003 and 2020, 452 unrelated probands with a diagnosis of AN were referred to our laboratory for molecular genetic investigation with

pmc-12623378.title: Association between dietary choline intake and odds of preeclampsia: a case–control study
pmc-12623378.creator: Junhua Zhu, Yacong Bo, Ruixue Ma, Ziwei Jiang, Jiahan Wang, Zheng Yuan, Xianlan Zhao, Yuan Cao, Dandan Duan, Weifeng Dou, Yanhua Liu, Quanjun Lyu
pmc-12623378.description: BackgroundPreeclampsia (PE) is a leading cause of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality. Choline, essential in one-carbon metabolism and vascular function, may influence placental health. We examined associations of total, subtype-, and source-specific dietary choline with PE odds in Chinese women.MethodsWe conducted a 1:1 matched case–control study of 982 pregnant women (491 PE cases; 491 controls) in Zhengzhou, China.

pmc-12674110.title: Fluorescent Protein Solid‐State Luminescent Solar Concentrators
pmc-12674110.creator: Sihan Lei, Sara Ferrara, Sanchari Chowdhury, Ruben D Costa
pmc-12674110.description: Building integration of Silicon‐photovoltaic (Si‐PV) panels into urban infrastructure faces efficiency and aesthetic concerns. An effective alternative is the luminescent solar concentrators (LSCs), in which the emitters embedded in polymer blocks capture, converts, and guide the sun irradiation to the edges where Si‐PV panels are placed.

pmc-12975822.title: Biocontrol potential of Aspergillus section Nigri strains against Aspergillus carbonarius
pmc-12975822.creator: Júlia Marquès, Kaitlyn Parra, Gemma Castellá, F. Javier Cabañes
pmc-12975822.description: Aspergillus carbonarius is the main producer of ochratoxin A (OTA) in grape and grape products. Good agricultural practices and preventive measures such as the use of biological control agents are key to decreasing OTA concentration in the final product. This study evaluated non-ochratoxigenic strains from Aspergillus section Nigri isolated from grape environments for their ability to control OTA production.

pmc-12982154.title: Chronic graft versus host disease in upper limb: Calling upper limb rehabilitation specialists for improving outcomes in patients
pmc-12982154.creator: Jaleel A. Mohammed, Caroline Couthard, Ahmed AlGhamdi, Collins Ogbeivor, Shahrukh K. Hashmi
pmc-12982154.description: BackgroundChronic graft versus host disease (cGVHD) is a complex post-transplant complication resulting in varying degrees of musculoskeletal (MSK) manifestations, including sclerosis-type skin conditions, fasciitis, and osteopenia, avascular necrosis affecting the shoulder, elbow and hands apart from other joints of the body. A large proportion of these can often miss out on the expertise of upper limb therapists.

pmc-13023364.title: Anxiety modulates odour-linked brain connectivity and alcohol dependence risk
pmc-13023364.creator: Khushbu Agarwal, Shefali Chaudhary, Valentina Parma, Yatan Pal Singh Balhara, Siddharth Sarkar
pmc-13023364.description: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) often emerges in adolescence and young adulthood, yet early neural predictors remain scarce. The olfactory system, through its connections with limbic and reward circuits, may provide a novel window into compulsive alcohol use. These brain regions are altered in AUD, but the role of olfactory pathways is poorly understood.

pmc-13145745.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1071 PROGNOSTIC IMPLICATIONS OF CEREBRAL AND SYSTEMIC HEMODYNAMICS IN A UK-BASED SEVERE ACUTE INTRACEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE COHORT
pmc-13145745.creator: Jennifer Nicholls, Corry Gellatly, Meeriam Kadicheeni, Ronney Panerai, Thompson Robinson, Hiren Patel, Adrian Parry-Jones, Jatinder Minhas
pmc-13145745.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsSpontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage (ICH) is associated with high morbidity and mortality. We investigated associations between cerebral and systemic haemodynamic parameters, including intracranial pressure (ICP), and mortality risk post-ICH in a UK intensive care unit (ITU).MethodsThis retrospective cohort included 120 patients ≥18 years old admitted to ITU between June 2013 and April 2019 with spontaneous ICH, who underwent continuous monitoring.

pmc-13182872.title: Identifying Donor Immune Cells in the Intestinal Mucosa of Chimeric Recipient Mice by Immunofluorescence
pmc-13182872.creator: Vinicius Canale, Samuel Asiedu, Fuad Malki, Gang Chen, Meera G Nair, Declan F McCole
pmc-13182872.description: Murine competitive congenic bone marrow transplantation is an important method used to identify genetic contributions to immune cell abundance, activation, differentiation, and mobilization, either in the bone marrow or in the peripheral organs of the host. This enables analysis of interactions between cells from both donors in relation to each other and the host itself.

pmc-13299271.title: Ethical and Clinical Boundaries in Genomics & Newborn Screening: A Brief Report from IPIC2025
pmc-13299271.creator: Raquel Yahyaoui, Lúcia Mamede, Martin Zach, James Taylor, Claire Booth, Rosalind Fisher, Věra Franková, Adli Ali, Johan Prevot, Martine Pergent, Roberta Anido de Pena, Elizabeth Rivers

pmc-13382157.title: Tumor‐type–specific expression of TTF‐1 in primary central nervous system tumors classified by the 2021 WHO criteria
pmc-13382157.creator: Lu Xu, Hong‐Jiu Ren, Jian Gu, Bing‐Wen Shan, Tong Ren, Chu‐Hang Liu, Chun‐Xian Cai, Xiao‐Yu Zhang, Juan‐Han Yu
pmc-13382157.description: Thyroid transcription factor‐1 (TTF‐1) is a widely used immunohistochemical marker for tumors of thyroid and pulmonary origin; however, its expression profile and diagnostic relevance in primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors remain incompletely characterized, particularly following the revisions in the 2021 WHO Classification of CNS Tumors.

pmc-13490627.title: Ligand‑Based Virtual Screening Discovery of Thienopyrimidinone Derivatives as Allosteric nSMase2 Modulators and Antivirals Against West Nile Virus
pmc-13490627.creator: Hadrián Álvarez‐Fernández, Patricia Mingo‐Casas, Ana‐Belén Blázquez, Flavia Caridi, Miguel A Martín‐Acebes, María‐Jesús Pérez‐Pérez, Eva‐María Priego

pmc-13538644.title: The impoverishing effect of tobacco expenditures
pmc-13538644.creator: Elvina Merkaj, Drini Imami, Edvin Zhllima, Jeffrey Drope
pmc-13538644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tobacco consumption is a major source of health and financial burden, yet evidence on its association with household poverty remains limited. This study examines how tobacco-related expenditures are associated with both the incidence and depth of poverty in Albania. Using nationally representative data from the Household Budget Survey, we estimate poverty indicators under three alternative definitions of household resources: observed expenditure, expenditure net of tobacco spending, and expenditure net of both tobacco and smoking-attributable healthcare costs.

pmc-13656191.title: The FOXQ1/SSBP2 Regulatory Axis Drives Malignant Progression of Melanoma
pmc-13656191.creator: Xiaoyu Zhang, Yu Hou, Jiahui Liu, Yuehua Han, Jiangang Feng
pmc-13656191.description: Melanoma is a highly aggressive skin cancer with poor prognosis, often linked to excessive UV exposure. Despite advancements in immunotherapy and targeted treatments, melanoma's invasiveness and metastatic potential remain significant challenges. This study aimed to identify novel molecular targets associated with melanoma progression. Consensus clustering analysis revealed three melanoma subtypes, with the C3 subtype exhibiting the worst prognosis.
